title: Evidence-based graduate feedback draft for instructor review

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Verify paper identity, assignment/course, actual current rubric bands/weights/denominator and instructor scoring scope before scored drafting.
If rubric binding is unavailable, continue evidence-only observations and leave score unresolved; never substitute historical Summer rubrics.
Use verified seven-section UD template. Archived six-part template, two-issue cap, reflective exclusion and clipped voice require explicit reconciliation.
Keep full instructor deduction ledger and student-facing feedback consistent; concerns outside rubric are unscored open calls.

success_checks: Header, rubric table if bound, genre flag, actual quoted commendation, deduction ledger, student-facing version and open calls are present as applicable.
Every proposed point decision cites exact paper evidence and applicable criterion; no invented quotation or location.
Saved outputs are instructor-review drafts; no grade approval, posting or delivery is inferred.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
